description: Engine #1 oil servicing — top up CFM56-5B reservoir within MIN/MAX range (AMM 12-13-79-680-001). Use Mobil Jet Oil II. Verify sight glass + magnetic chip detector for FOD.
partsRequired: Mobil Jet Oil II, 5L NATO O-156

description: Engine #2 oil servicing — V2500 IAE reservoir top-up to nominal level (AMM 12-13-79-680-002). Replace breather cap if seal degraded. Sign sight-glass check on tech log.
partsRequired: Mobil Jet Oil II, 5L NATO O-156

description: Hydraulic Green system — replenish reservoir to FULL mark with Skydrol LD-4 (AMM 12-12-29-610-001). Verify pump pressure 3000 PSI ±150. Check ground-test connectors capped.
Hydraulic Yellow system — replenish reservoir + bleed entrapped air (AMM 12-12-29-610-002). Check PTU operation post-servicing. Inspect quick-disconnects for weeping.
Daily visual MLI (Maintenance Look-in Inspection) — walkaround per AMM 05-10-15. Check fuselage skin panels, NLG/MLG struts, leading edges, engine cowls, static ports. Sign-off OAS.
Cabin temperature sensor Zone 1 — R&I LRU at FR47 (AMM 21-61-46-000-001). Verify resistance 1kΩ @25°C post-install. Run zone temp test via CIDS.
Pack 1 outlet temperature check — verify 15-25°C at cabin inlet during ground run (AMM 21-51-00-720-002). Trend log compressor outlet temp + flow valve position.
Cabin recirculation fan R&I (FWD lower) — replace P/N 7384-100 (AMM 21-26-32-000-001). Vibration analysis post-fit: < 0.15 IPS at 5800 RPM. Reseal acoustic insulation.
Pack 2 flow control valve R&I — replace FCV P/N 89241-1 (AMM 21-51-21-000-005). Torque attach bolts 82-90 in-lb. Functional test: full-open to full-close ≤ 4s.
Ram air inlet FOD inspection — borescope check inside RAI duct (AMM 21-61-00-200-001). Look for ice damage, bird strike residue, loose fasteners. Photo-document findings.
Forward avionics ventilation fan R&I — extract LRU from rack 80VU (AMM 21-58-13-000-003). Verify 28VDC supply, test air flow 1.2-1.5 m³/min. ESD precautions required.
Cabin Pressurization Controller (CPC) functional test — simulate climb/cruise/descent profile via CPC test set (AMM 21-31-15-720-001). Verify outflow valve tracking ± 50 ft.
Cargo bay heating element R&I — bulk cargo zone (AMM 21-43-00-000-002). Verify continuity 2-3Ω, dielectric test 1500VDC for 60s. Re-seal insulation blanket.
FMGC #1 hard drive replacement — Honeywell FMS LRU at rack 90VU (AMM 22-71-21-000-008). Backup OPS config + AIRAC pre-removal. ESD wrist required. Run IBIT post-fit.
FMGC navigation database update — load AIRAC cycle via MCDU SELECTED PERF page (AMM 22-71-31-720-001). Verify cycle date + checksum. Cross-check #1 and #2 align.
Autopilot disengage warning aural test — both AP1/AP2 (AMM 22-13-00-720-001). Verify cavalry charge + master warning red + ECAM message. Sound level ≥85 dB at FDA position.
MCDU #1 display LRU replacement — captain side (AMM 22-71-65-000-001). Calibrate brightness curve post-fit. Verify keypad backlight + lateral select keys responsive.
Autothrust gain calibration — both ATHR channels (AMM 22-32-15-720-005). Inject simulated throttle position 0-100%, verify N1 response curve within ±0.3% RPM.
VHF1 transceiver R&I — Collins RT-1701A LRU (AMM 23-12-21-000-001). After fit: verify 121.5 emergency freq, squelch threshold, modulation index. Antenna VSWR < 1.5.
HF antenna coupler R&I — vertical stab tip (AMM 23-22-12-000-002). Requires ladder + safety harness >2m. Tune across 2-30 MHz band post-install. Bond check < 2.5 mΩ.
CVR control panel R&I — overhead 22VU (AMM 23-71-11-000-001). Test ERASE button latched (≥2s press required). Verify 25-hour recording + impact survival circuit.
PA system functional test — all zones + boarding/safety announcements (AMM 23-32-00-720-001). Verify chime priority, intercom prio over PA. Min volume 84 dB at row 10.
SATCOM SDU (Satellite Data Unit) R&I — Inmarsat Aero-H (AMM 23-25-11-000-001). Validate antenna handoff during yaw. Login session test with ground station post-fit.
Main battery #1 (Ni-Cd 24V 23Ah) R&I — fwd cargo equipment bay (AMM 24-31-31-000-001). Capacity test ≥85% rated. Electrolyte top-up if needed. Battery lift mandatory.
TR1 (Transformer-Rectifier #1) output test — verify 28VDC ± 0.3V at full load (AMM 24-31-21-720-002). Check ripple < 1.5V p-p. Thermography of TR housing if available.
IDG #2 (Integrated Drive Generator) R&I — V2500 LH side (AMM 24-21-51-000-001). Disconnect requires generator pre-disengage. Oil drain mandatory. Heavy lift 38kg+.
28VDC bus contactor R&I — main battery DC bus (AMM 24-51-21-000-003). Verify contact resistance < 1 mΩ. Functional close/open test 5 cycles min. Mark cable polarity.
Ground service network inspection — connector W201, W202 cabin (AMM 24-41-00-200-001). Check pin condition + crimp integrity. Test 115VAC presence with GPU connected.
Static inverter R&I — converts 28VDC to 115VAC essential bus (AMM 24-22-32-000-001). Test output frequency 400Hz ±5Hz + voltage 115VAC ±3V under load.
Cabin sunvisor RH row 12 — replace cracked assembly P/N D5247-25 (AMM 25-23-44-000-007). Clean adjacent window seal. Verify visor stays in down position (friction lock).
Passenger seat 18C cushion R&I — replace fire-blocked cushion P/N 4-18C (AMM 25-22-21-000-012). Verify fire-block certification tag visible. Reattach safety belt clip.
Tray table hinge repair — seat 7A (AMM 25-23-11-300-002). Replace hinge P/N TH-21 + lubricate pivot point. Verify tray locks at horizontal + stowed positions.
Galley G1 coffee maker R&I — Aerolux unit P/N GAL-CM-2 (AMM 25-32-11-000-001). Verify 115VAC supply + GFCI trip protection. Run flush cycle post-install.
Lavatory door latch LAV-A R&I — replace mechanism + occupied lamp interlock (AMM 25-31-44-000-005). Verify smoke detector connection intact. Test 3-cycle lock.
Overhead bin handles row 8-11 — 4 units replacement P/N OVH-HND-A (AMM 25-25-32-000-003). Torque latch screws 18-22 in-lb. Verify slam-close + latched lockout.
Reading light LED row 22 — 4 units replacement P/N LED-RL-1 (AMM 33-25-11-000-002). Verify 28VDC supply + PSU dimmer function. Discard old LEDs per RoHS protocol.
Cabin attendant seat belt R&I — door 2L position (AMM 25-65-22-000-001). Verify reel retraction force 18-25N + emergency lock < 1G. Inspect anchor point structure.
partsRequired: FA seat belt assy P/N FA-SB-2L

description: PSU (Passenger Service Unit) row 14 — repair gasper outlet + reading lamp circuit (AMM 25-25-71-000-005). Verify oxygen-mask drop test pin intact (do not actuate test on cabin).
Lavatory LAV-C smoke detector test — Apollo 65-3 (AMM 26-16-21-720-002). Inject test aerosol + verify alarm + ECAM warning + CIDS report. Reset latched circuit.
Cargo fire detection loop test — fwd + aft cargo loops A/B (AMM 26-16-00-720-001). Verify single-loop fault + dual-loop fire indications + ECAM message + bottle armed.
Engine #1 fire extinguisher squib R&I — both bottles (AMM 26-21-43-000-001). Squib continuity 0.9-1.4Ω. PIN safety mandatory until reconnect. Bond strap < 5 mΩ.
APU fire detector loops A+B inspection — Kidde sensor chain (AMM 26-15-21-200-001). Visual condition + clamp integrity. Bench-test resistance 600-900Ω at 25°C.
Slat #1 actuator motor R&I — wing LH leading edge (AMM 27-81-15-000-001). Disconnect MOC hydraulic supply. Torque mount bolts 145-160 ft-lb. Travel test full retract→extend ≤ 22s.
RTLU (Rudder Travel Limit Unit) test — measure rudder authority vs CAS (AMM 27-22-12-720-002). Verify hardover protection at high speed. Trim back to zero.
Flap track carriage lubrication — all 8 carriages (AMM 27-51-00-690-001). Apply Aeroshell 22 grease, max 2 strokes per fitting. Cycle flaps 0/15/20/40 for distribution.
Spoiler #4 servo control R&I — RH wing position (AMM 27-61-31-000-001). Hydraulic isolation Green system. Test deploy 0-30° response ≤ 1.5s. Check signal continuity.
Elevator hinge bearing inspection — outer 4 + inner 2 per side (AMM 27-31-00-200-002). Check for fretting + corrosion. Measure free play < 0.3mm. Borescope sealed bearings.
Aileron position transmitter R&I — LH outboard (AMM 27-11-15-000-002). Calibrate zero + full deflection ± 15°. Verify ELAC1/ELAC2 input signal both channels.
Fuel transfer pump R&I — wing tank center transfer (AMM 28-22-12-000-001). Strict fire-watch + bonding mandatory. Test capacity ≥ 11 USG/min at 35 PSI. Leak check 5 min.
Fuel Quantity Indication System (FQIS) test — all tanks (AMM 28-41-00-720-001). Inject test signal at FQPU, verify ECAM FUEL page values. Check capacitive probes Ω.
Center tank scavenge pump R&I — bay 7 (AMM 28-22-15-000-003). Verify suction lift 14 in-Hg + delivery pressure 35 PSI. Bonding check < 25 mΩ to airframe.
Fuel jettison valve servicing — A321 only (AMM 28-32-00-690-001). Functional cycle 5 open/close. Inspect filter screen. Replace seals if hardened. Bond check.
Green system pressure transducer R&I — EDP outlet line (AMM 29-11-15-000-002). Hydraulic depress mandatory. Verify 2700-3150 PSI nominal. Output 4-20mA linearity.
RAT (Ram Air Turbine) deployment inspection — visual only, NO actual deploy (AMM 29-21-00-200-001). Check stowage latch + condition of blades + safety pin position.
Yellow accumulator N2 pre-charge — service to 1900 PSI ± 50 (AMM 29-12-25-610-001). Use dry nitrogen only, never compressed air. Bleed/recharge cycle if pressure low.
Hydraulic reservoir level sensor R&I — Green or Yellow (AMM 29-11-26-000-001). Magnetic float type — bench-test continuity at MIN/REFILL/MAX positions before fit.
PTU (Power Transfer Unit) servicing — Green↔Yellow hydraulic bidirectional (AMM 29-13-21-690-001). AOG: fluid contamination found. Filter change + flush cycle mandatory.
Pitot heat element R&I — captain probe (AMM 30-31-12-000-001). Resistance 12.5-15Ω cold. Bond to airframe < 2.5 mΩ. Heat-on test min surface 70°C in 30s.
Wing anti-ice valve operational test — both sides (AMM 30-11-15-720-001). Cycle open/close 3× via overhead panel. Verify response < 6s + ECAM correct indication.
Engine inlet TAI (Thermal Anti-Ice) valve R&I — CFM56 LH (AMM 30-21-15-000-001). Engine MUST be cold-state. Verify cycle 4 open/close + ECAM ANTI ICE indication.
MLG #1 wheel+tire assembly R&I — Bridgestone H39x14.0-19 (AMM 32-45-11-000-001). Jack aircraft per AMM 07-10-00. Torque axle nut 250-300 ft-lb. Bearing repack.
MLG #2 brake unit R&I — Honeywell carbon (AMM 32-45-15-000-002). Critical — return-to-service requires brake-cool test + dragging brake check on jack rotation.
NLG steering actuator service — replace dynamic seals (AMM 32-51-12-690-001). Yellow hydraulic depress mandatory. Cycle steering ±75° post-fit, no scrubbing/binding allowed.
MLG shock strut servicing inspection — both struts (AMM 32-11-00-690-001). Measure extension at empty weight per chart. If low, recharge with N2 + oil per ratio.
Gear position proximity sensor R&I — MLG up-lock target (AMM 32-31-15-000-003). Air-gap 2.0 ± 0.2 mm. Functional test full retract/extend + ECAM LGCIU agreement.
Brake cooling fans service — 4 units per MLG (AMM 32-49-21-690-001). Visual + bearing free-rotation check. Replace bearing if drag > 0.1 N-m. Confirm 28VDC supply.
Tire Pressure Indicator (TPI) replacement — 4 units MLG (AMM 32-46-11-000-001). Calibrate against master gauge 0-300 PSI. RF link to cockpit display verified.
NLG torque link bushing inspection — upper + lower bushings (AMM 32-21-00-200-001). Measure radial play, max 0.5mm. Replace if exceeded. Lubricate per AMM 12-25-00.
Landing light LH R&I — sealed beam GE Q4559X (AMM 33-42-11-000-001). 28VDC 250W. Step ladder + 2-person lift recommended. Aim per template post-install.
Navigation light RH wing — replace LED unit + diffuser (AMM 33-41-21-000-002). Verify 28VDC. Photometric output green ≥ 7 cd at 110° per FAR 25.1389. Bonding check.
Taxi light LH NLG R&I — LED Whelen 90120 series (AMM 33-43-11-000-001). Verify aim 4° below horizon, taxi-light mode separate from landing. Confirm vibration mount.
Anti-collision beacon (top fuselage) R&I — Whelen 8060 LED (AMM 33-44-11-000-001). Lift required, fuselage top access. Verify flash rate 40-100 fpm per FAR 25.1401.
Logo light vertical stab R&I — illuminates tail livery (AMM 33-46-11-000-001). Lift mandatory (height >10m). Aim cone covers entire tail surface. Cosmetic-only, defer ok.
Radio altimeter transceiver R&I — Honeywell RT-300 LRU (AMM 34-33-12-000-001). Calibrate against ramp test set 0-2500 ft. Antenna VSWR < 1.4 + bond strap < 5 mΩ.
EGPWS terrain database test — load latest cycle + verify TAWS callouts (AMM 34-46-31-720-001). Run scenario: approach KMAD RWY 32L, expect 'TERRAIN AHEAD PULL UP' at 800ft AGL.
MMR (Multi-Mode Receiver) #1 R&I — Rockwell Collins GLU-925 (AMM 34-37-11-000-001). Cold-start IBIT + GPS lock < 90s. ILS test signal localizer/glideslope deviation.
TCAS interrogator calibration — Honeywell TPA-100B (AMM 34-44-15-720-001). Mode-S address verify. Test resolution advisory (RA) logic with two airborne intruders.
Pitot probe heat controller R&I — Heater Control Unit (AMM 34-12-15-000-001). Verify HEAT-OFF when ground state, HEAT-ON automatically with WoW signal removed.
Crew oxygen bottle R&I — Cobham 50 cu-ft @ 1850 PSI (AMM 35-11-21-000-001). Hydrostatic test date current. Bonding strap + regulator pressure check post-install.
Passenger oxygen generators test — chemical type, all rows (AMM 35-22-00-720-001). DO NOT actuate. Pull test pins verify intact + manifest current. Inspect rusty cans.
Portable O2 bottle FWD lavatory R&I — Sherwood 311 (AMM 35-31-12-000-001). 311L STD 1800 PSI. Verify pressure ≥ 1500 PSI for service. Mask + regulator check.
BMC (Bleed Monitoring Controller) R&I — both engines + APU monitored (AMM 36-22-15-000-001). Reload software config. Verify HP/IP bleed valve commands match overhead panel.
High Pressure (HP) bleed valve operational test — engine #1 (AMM 36-12-15-720-001). Cycle open/close via overhead panel. Verify 40-65 PSI bleed pressure at idle.
Crossbleed valve R&I — interconnects engine #1 ↔ engine #2 bleed (AMM 36-13-21-000-001). Cycle test full open/close ≤ 8s. Leak check < 5 PSI/min @ 30 PSI seal.
Potable water tank service — 50-gal fwd tank (AMM 38-11-00-690-001). Drain + sanitize per chlorine protocol 50 ppm/30 min. Refill with potable water. Cap inspect.
Lavatory flush motor LAV-A R&I — Monogram vacuum waste (AMM 38-32-21-000-001). Verify vacuum 8-12 in-Hg + dry-cycle test no leaks. Replace inlet hose if cracked.
Grey water drain galley G1 inspection — heater + drain mast (AMM 38-21-15-200-001). Check for ice plugs in mast (winter ops). Drain heater 200W functional verify.
APU oil pressure switch R&I — Honeywell GTCP131-9A (AMM 49-32-21-000-001). Verify trip @ 35 ± 5 PSI rising. Bonding check < 5 mΩ. APU run test post-fit.
APU air inlet door actuator test — verify full open ≤ 6s at APU start command (AMM 49-15-12-720-001). Mechanical interlock + position switch agreement check.
APU Fuel Control Unit R&I — Honeywell ECU-49 (AMM 49-91-15-000-001). Critical: software config restore + N speed governor calibration. Bonding < 2.5 mΩ.
Pax door 1L slide raft R&I — Goodrich BA31 (AMM 52-71-15-000-001). PIN safety mandatory during install (do NOT arm). Hydro test date current. Heavy lift required.
partsRequired: Slide raft assy Goodrich BA31 (in-date hydro)

description: Door 2R seal R&I — perimeter inflatable bulb seal (AMM 52-31-15-000-002). Verify pressurization integrity post-install. Bond + grounding tab clean of corrosion.
Cargo door 1 (FWD) hydraulic damper service — yellow system (AMM 52-43-15-690-001). Bleed air from damper + verify door-open hold position. Re-grease pivot points.
Door rubbing strip R&I — door 3L sill (AMM 52-31-22-000-005). Replace worn metal strip + reseal with PR-1422 sealant. Inspect aluminum corrosion underneath.
Emergency exit door 2L handle inspection — visual integrity + travel test (AMM 52-21-15-200-002). Verify door-open assist mechanism arms when handle pulled.
Cockpit windshield wiper motor #1 R&I — captain side (AMM 56-21-11-000-001). Verify slow/fast speeds + park position. Inspect blade wear, replace if separation > 1mm.
Windshield heating element resistance check — both pilot windshields (AMM 56-11-15-200-001). Verify 1.2-2.8Ω at 25°C. Inspect for delamination/arc-tracking with backlight.
Engine #1 oil filter R&I (CFM56-5B) — main lube filter (AMM 71-71-15-000-001). Cut filter post-removal + inspect debris under microscope. SOAP sample if metal found.
Engine #2 oil filter R&I (V2500-A5) — main lube + scavenge filters (AMM 71-71-15-000-002). Torque housing 35-45 ft-lb. Run engine post-fit, check pressure stable.
Engine #1 HP turbine borescope inspection — CFM56-5B (AMM 72-50-00-200-001). Inspect stages 1-2 NGV + blades. Photo-document any blade tip rubs or cracks. Issue ALOC.
